newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Angry Russian injures self, ex-wife with grenade.
newsitem.headline: Angry Russian injures self, ex-wife with grenade.

text.p: A man let off a hand grenade on a train in Russia's turbulent North Caucasus on Tuesday, blowing his arm off and wounding his ex-wife and two other women, police said.
"This was a quarrel between this man and his ex-wife," said a police spokesman from Vladikavkaz, capital of the North Ossetia region.
All three injured women were conductors on the stationary train and were sitting together in a compartment.
